footer.tagline: A calm word game, one letter at a time.
footer.note: Your progress stays on this device.

welcome.title: Welcome to Hanglet
welcome.text: A calm word game for every day. Let's set it up for you.

tour.label: Quick tour
tour.word: This is the hidden word. Every tile is one letter.
tour.category: The category is your first clue.
tour.picture: Look at the picture and the clue. They help you find the word!
tour.keyboard: Tap a letter to guess. Try one now!
tour.goodGuess: Nice! That letter is in the word.
tour.wrongGuess: That letter is not in the word. No problem, keep trying!
tour.figure: Every wrong letter changes the figure. Find the word before it is finished.
tour.hints: Stuck? Use a hint: show a description, reveal a letter or remove wrong letters.
tour.hintsFree: Stuck? Tap Hint. In Kids mode hints are free!

setup.classicIntro: Pick your options and play as many words as you like.
setup.timedIntro: The clock starts as soon as you press start. A missed word costs no time, just move on!

play.letterWrong: {letter} is not in the word. {count} lives left.

hints.title: Pick a hint
hints.notEnough: You need {coins} coins for this hint.
hints.lettersRemoved: Hint: {letters} are not in the word.

description.title: Show the description
description.text: A short sentence about the word

remove.title: Remove 3 wrong letters
remove.text: Three letters that are not in the word disappear

daily.title: Daily
daily.text: Three words a day, the same for everyone. About 5 minutes.
daily.comeBack: Come back tomorrow for new words

classic.title: Classic
classic.subtitle: Endless play, word after word
classic.text: Endless play. Choose category, length and difficulty.

levels.title: Levels
levels.text: Follow the map through 40 levels, from easy to tough.

timed.title: Time Attack
timed.subtitle: Solve as many words as you can in 2 minutes
timed.text: Solve as many words as you can before the clock runs out.

kids.title: Kids
kids.subtitle: Easy words with a picture
kids.text: Short, easy words with a picture. Big buttons and free hints.

share.classic: I solved a {count}-letter word in Hanglet with {misses}. {link}
share.level: I finished level {number} in Hanglet with {stars} of 3 stars. {link}
share.timed: I solved {count} words in 2 minutes in Hanglet Time Attack. {link}

levels.title: Level map
levels.intro: Win a level to unlock the next one. Fewer misses means more stars.

home.title: Guess the word, one letter at a time.
home.intro: Hanglet is a calm word game for all ages. Pick a letter, fill in the word and save your figure. New Daily words every day.
home.dictionaryEmpty: Every word you solve is saved here, with its meaning.
home.step1Text: The category tells you what kind of word you are looking for.
home.step2Text: Tap a letter or type it. Right letters fill the word, wrong ones change the figure.
home.step3Text: Earn XP and coins, unlock figures and themes, and fill your dictionary.
home.offlineText: Add Hanglet to your home screen. It works without internet.

dictionary.title: My dictionary
dictionary.intro: Every word you solved, with its meaning. Can you collect them all?
dictionary.empty: Your dictionary is still empty. Solve a word to add it here.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.intro: Everything you have done so far. Saved on this device only.
stats.chartEmpty: Play a game to see your chart.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Make Hanglet look, sound and feel the way you like.
settings.kidsFirstHelp: Puts the Kids mode at the top of the home page
settings.themesHelp: Unlock new themes by leveling up and keeping your streak.
settings.figuresHelp: Choose what happens on the board. Unlock new figures with coins or badges.
settings.soundHelp: Short tones for right and wrong letters
settings.vibrationHelp: Buzz on a wrong letter (phones only)
settings.dataHelp: Your progress is saved in this browser only. Resetting removes your stats, coins, levels, badges, figures, dictionary and settings.
settings.resetText: This removes everything and can't be undone.

classic.name: Classic
classic.text: The well-known figure, drawn part by part

balloon.name: Balloon
balloon.text: Loses air with every miss and floats away when you win

flower.name: Flower
flower.text: Loses a petal with every miss

snowman.name: Snowman
snowman.text: Melts a little when the sun comes out

rocket.name: Rocket
rocket.text: Build it with right letters and watch it launch

flawless.name: Flawless
flawless.description: Win a game without a single miss

long-word.name: Long haul
long-word.description: Solve a word with 10 or more letters

timed-10.name: Speed reader
timed-10.description: Solve 10 words in one Time Attack

explorer.name: Explorer
explorer.description: Win a game in every category

kids-win.name: Young star
kids-win.description: Win a game in Kids mode

bilingual.name: Bilingual
bilingual.description: Solve words in English and in Dutch
